notes.title: Hotfix: Fixed newer Windows MR can't finish Tutorial.
notes.notes:
We must apologize to Windows MR users!  The last version supposed to fully support MR, but because we were using a older version MR device as develop tool, Made us didn't be able to located a bug which will cause user stuck at the end of Tutorial.

Now we finally fixed this bug, Hope you enjoy the game! Sorry again for the stupid mistake!
